title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-17
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain SRC > Wavelab (adding 16-bit patch) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 09/2016
source: Set 2 AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90, FOB recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a high‑energy first California show, capturing the excitement despite windy conditions.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its crystal‑clear sound even with wind at the Ventura fairgrounds, making it one of the best taper recordings in the collection. Reviewers were thrilled by the personal significance of this being their first West Coast gig, describing the night as unforgettable and full of excitement, though no specific musical moments are called out.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive feedback on recording quality (excellent) and overall show energy, but limited detail on musical performance leads to a moderate confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is described as amazing and crisp despite wind; the taper team delivered a clear, balanced mix that rivals other recordings in the archive.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on song order or pacing; reviewers focused on the overall excitement of their first California show.
